visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with hair in two pigtails walks down a dirt path in an outdoor orchard. She wears a beige sweatshirt with white fleece panels and brown plaid pants, carrying a multicolored striped bag while chewing on a yellow snack. A man in a beige jacket and glasses stands nearby, holding a green plastic bag and a container of food. The setting is a sunny, open-air agricultural area with green trees and a clear sky in the background. (2) The camera focuses on the young girl standing under the canopy of orange trees. She continues to chew on her snack, appearing indifferent to the harvest activities. The background features lush green foliage and numerous ripe oranges hanging from branches, illuminated by bright, natural daylight. Another toddler in a similar outfit is visible in the background, also exploring the orchard. (3) A woman in a grey shirt picks up the young girl, holding her close to the low-hanging fruit. The woman uses a pair of green garden shears to cut a large orange while the girl holds the fruit with her small hands, still keeping the snack in her mouth. The scene captures the close physical interaction during the fruit-picking activity. (4) After the orange is harvested, the girl is placed back on the ground near a striped bag. She picks up the fallen fruit and places it into the bag. Another older girl in a matching sweatshirt appears, smiling and proudly showing a large orange to the camera. The family remains in the sun-drenched orchard surrounded by dense orange trees. (5) The video concludes with a static pink background featuring a cute cartoon illustration of a girl holding an orange with the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' centered on the screen. The graphic is flat and brightly colored, serving as a standard social media outro.
